articles.title: Morgan Sindall Group And 2 Other British Undervalued Stocks
articles.summary: AI related goods are driving a powerful new wave of global trade, and that puts steady cash generation back in the spotlight. Cash rich British businesses that trade below estimates of their fair value can give you exposure to this trend without paying AI bubble prices. This article looks at three UK listed cash flow machines that screen as undervalued on a discounted cash flow basis.
